description: This file contains unit tests for the `CatalogFilterSpecification` class, which filters catalog items based on brand and type IDs. The tests verify the correctness of the specification's evaluation logic within the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: CatalogFilterSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for the CatalogFilterSpecification, testing filtering logic of catalog items based on brand and type.

methods.name: MatchesExpectedNumberOfItems
methods.description: Test method that checks whether the filtering specification correctly matches the expected number of catalog items given different brand and type filters.

methods.name: GetTestItemCollection
methods.description: Provides a list of sample catalog items used in the unit tests for evaluating the filtering specification.
